description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Linked Materia Mode II (Wind, Holy)], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Pride Mode I (Angeal)] and [(Wind/Holy) Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Pride Mode I (Angeal)
description.text: Wind and Holy abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Wind and Holy abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00/x2.50/x3.00 and critical chance =50%/75%/100% for equipped Wind and Holy abilities after casting 1/2/3+ Wind and Holy abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Pride Mode II (Angeal)], grant [100% Critical 3] and [Wind/Holy Ability Instant Cast 3] if 4+ FF7 allies are alive, removes [Dual Awoken Pride Mode I (Angeal)] from the user

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Pride Mode II (Angeal)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap by 10000, Wind and Holy abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Wind and Holy abilities trigger 1 additional time, grants [Wind Ability +30% Boost 1] to Cloud, Zack and the user if Cloud or Zack are alive after using Wind or Holy abilities

description.name: Wind/Holy Ability Instant Cast 3
description.text: Instant cast speed for Wind and Holy abilities

description.name: Linked Materia Mode II (Wind, Holy)
description.text: Grants [Attach Wind with Stacking]/[Attach Holy with Stacking] after using a Wind/Holy ability

description.name: (Wind/Holy) Resonance +5% Boost
description.text: Wind and Holy abilities deal 5% more damage
